newsitem.title: CANADA: Biovail jumps on positive Barron's article.
newsitem.headline: Biovail jumps on positive Barron's article.

text.p: Biovail Corp International shares rose on Monday on a positive article on the company in Barron's, the company and analysts said.
"The article is to some degree (responsible) for the appreciation in the stock," said Biovail president Bruce Brydon." Barron's noted that Biovail's drug to combat hypertension might sell well.

Biovail gained as much as 6.90 to hit 43.90 before slipping to 42.50 in late dealings on the Toronto Stock Exchange. On the American Stock Exchange, Biovail rose 3-3/4 to 30-3/4 on more than 700,000 shares.
"It's a very positive article," added analyst Eddie Hedaya at BioVest Research Inc.
